sparqlExamples.label: Count triples by graph
Basic Classification metadata (Graph)
Terminologies about historical geography (Graph)
Terminology contact locations (Geo)
sparqlExamples.query:
PREFIX geo: <http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#>
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>

# Contact localities come from ADDRESS in a BARTOC JSKOS dump snapshot.
# WKT points use Wikidata P625 city-centre coordinates for this map example.
SELECT ?terminology ?label ?country ?locality ?wkt ?wktTooltip
WHERE {
  VALUES (?terminology ?country ?locality ?wkt) {
    (<http://bartoc.org/en/node/10> "Australia" "Canberra" "POINT(149.126944444 -35.293055555)"^^geo:wktLiteral)
    (<http://bartoc.org/en/node/100> "United States" "New York City" "POINT(-74.006111111 40.712777777)"^^geo:wktLiteral)
    (<http://bartoc.org/en/node/1000> "Brazil" "São Paulo" "POINT(-46.633947222 -23.550394444)"^^geo:wktLiteral)
    (<http://bartoc.org/en/node/1001> "Belgium" "Brussels" "POINT(4.351666666 50.846666666)"^^geo:wktLiteral)
    (<http://bartoc.org/en/node/1002> "Germany" "Erlangen" "POINT(11.005 49.5925)"^^geo:wktLiteral)
    (<http://bartoc.org/en/node/1003> "Canada" "Vancouver" "POINT(-123.113888888 49.260833333)"^^geo:wktLiteral)
    (<http://bartoc.org/en/node/1004> "Netherlands" "Amsterdam" "POINT(4.883333333 52.366666666)"^^geo:wktLiteral)
    (<http://bartoc.org/en/node/1005> "Spain" "Bilbao" "POINT(-2.935 43.263055555)"^^geo:wktLiteral)
    (<http://bartoc.org/en/node/1009> "United Kingdom" "London" "POINT(-0.1275 51.507222222)"^^geo:wktLiteral)
    (<http://bartoc.org/en/node/18570> "Republic of Korea" "Seoul" "POINT(126.99 37.56)"^^geo:wktLiteral)
  }
  GRAPH <https://bartoc.org/graph/terminology/> {
    ?terminology a skos:ConceptScheme ;
      skos:prefLabel ?label .
    FILTER (LANG(?label) = "en")
  }
  BIND(STR(?label) AS ?wktTooltip)
}

sparqlExamples.label: Terminologies by contact country (Geo)
sparqlExamples.query:
# Counts come from a BARTOC JSKOS dump snapshot: 4,150 schemes,
# including 3,286 with ADDRESS.country. Coordinates use Wikidata P625.
SELECT ?country ?terminologies ?lat ?lon ?wktTooltip
WHERE {
  VALUES (?country ?terminologies ?lat ?lon) {
    ("Republic of Korea" 614 36.0 128.0)
    ("United States" 608 39.828175 -98.5795)
    ("Germany" 496 51.0 10.0)
    ("United Kingdom" 212 54.6 -2.0)
    ("Spain" 191 40.2 -3.5)
    ("France" 141 47.0 2.0)
    ("Luxembourg" 139 49.77 6.13)
    ("Switzerland" 97 46.798562 8.231973)
    ("Finland" 93 65.0 27.0)
    ("Canada" 85 56.0 -109.0)
    ("Australia" 79 -25.0 133.0)
    ("Italy" 72 42.5 12.5)
    ("Austria" 52 48.0 14.0)
    ("New Zealand" 47 -41.2 174.0)
    ("Belgium" 44 50.641111111 4.668055555)
  }
  BIND(CONCAT(?country, ": ", STR(?terminologies)) AS ?wktTooltip)
}
ORDER BY DESC(?terminologies)

sparqlExamples.label: Classes by number of instances
Properties by number of triples
Publishers
sparqlExamples.query:
PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>

SELECT ?publisher (COUNT(*) AS ?count)
WHERE {
  ?x dct:publisher ?publisher
}
GROUP BY ?publisher
ORDER BY DESC(?count)

sparqlExamples.label: Publishers with DDC main subjects
sparqlExamples.query:
PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX bartoc: <http://bartoc.org/en/node/>

SELECT ?publisher ?class ?label (COUNT(?terminology) AS ?count)
WHERE {
  ?terminology dct:publisher ?publisher .
  ?terminology dct:subject ?ddc .
  ?ddc skos:inScheme bartoc:241 .
  ?ddc skos:notation ?class .
  ?ddc skos:prefLabel ?label .
  FILTER (STRLEN(?class) = 1)
}
GROUP BY ?publisher ?class ?label
ORDER BY DESC(?count)

sparqlExamples.label: Terminologies by decade of creation
sparqlExamples.query:
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/>

SELECT ?decade (COUNT(?terminology) AS ?count)
WHERE {
  ?terminology a skos:ConceptScheme .
  ?terminology schema:startDate ?date .
  BIND(CONCAT(SUBSTR(STR(?date), 1, 3), "0") AS ?decade)
}
GROUP BY ?decade
ORDER BY ?decade
